answer: Mechanism: Geocell Proof-of-Place. Each agent identity is anchored to a unique 10 m² geocell and must submit weekly tamper-resistant sensor attestations (soil moisture, wind, spectral reflectance). One active identity per cell; neighboring cells are cross-checked for spatial consistency across meadow, dune, and vine-canopy deployments. Attacker cost: physically occupy and maintain many distinct cells with calibrated hardware for months; virtual identities collide or fail consistency checks.
